notes.title: HUGE UPDATE FOR THREE HEROES THIS WEEK!
Balance update
notes.content:
You said that heroes is too slow and you need a lot of shots and strikes on the enemies to kill them. It is not good. We agreed. 
And we fixed it! Meet global balance update!

- attack power of every weapon, including enemy weapons, is increased by 200%
- movement and animation speed is increased by 50%
- speed penalties of every weapon are significantly reduced or removed totally
- effectiveness of bonus items (health and defend potion and etc) is increased by 50-100%
